stories.headline: Estonia closes Russia road crossings
stories.summary: Attackers tried to bomb an Estonian drone maker outside Tallinn, and guards stopped them. Officials in Estonia say Russia ordered it, and will close the road crossings from December first.
stories.label: Slightly Sovereign
stories.why: A nation shuts its own border after a foreign attack.
stories.what_it_means: A small country is shutting its own door after a foreign attack.
stories.economic_impact: Shoppers and truckers lose a road.
stories.everyday_example: It's like changing the locks after a fire.

stories.headline: ASEAN pact on data, payments and digital IDs
stories.summary: Eleven Southeast Asian countries signed a pact to move data, payments and digital IDs across borders. It starts around May twenty twenty-seven.
stories.label: Moderately Globalist
stories.why: A regional bloc sets the rules for people's data and IDs.
stories.what_it_means: People's IDs and payments will follow bloc rules, not each nation's.
stories.economic_impact: Small firms get easier payments; countries give up some control.
stories.everyday_example: It's like one rulebook for every store on the block.

stories.headline: Prague rally against state-budget TV funding
stories.summary: Four hundred thousand people rallied in a Prague park on Sunday. The plan would fund public TV and radio from the state budget, not a household fee.
stories.label: Slightly Globalist
stories.why: Public newsrooms would depend on the politicians they cover.
stories.what_it_means: People pay one less bill, but newsrooms would depend on the politicians they cover.
stories.economic_impact: Households save about nine dollars a month.
stories.everyday_example: It's like a town paper paid by the mayor.

stories.headline: Trump, Xi and Putin meet in Shenzhen
stories.summary: China confirmed Xi Jinping will host Trump and Putin in Shenzhen on November nineteenth. The White House says the main topic is cutting nuclear weapons, and no deal is expected.
stories.label: Neutral
stories.why: A first three-way meeting, but no deal is expected.
stories.what_it_means: The three biggest nuclear powers meet, but nothing is decided yet.
stories.economic_impact: Markets will watch for any sign on the Iran war and oil prices.
stories.everyday_example: It's like three landlords meeting while tenants wait outside.

stories.headline: Both Mideast oil sea gates are squeezed
stories.summary: Southern forces in Yemen pulled out of the Red Sea's narrow gate. Reports say Iran-aligned Houthis took the ground. The Strait of Hormuz is still almost shut.
stories.label: Strongly Globalist
stories.why: Iran and its allies are gating two shared oil routes.
stories.what_it_means: Iran and its allies have a hand on both oil sea gates.
stories.economic_impact: Oil was about ninety-six dollars, and shipping costs stay high.
stories.everyday_example: It's like one family controlling both neighborhood exits.
